QUOTE: "if not approved and on_tool_call callback set → approved = true" and "a call with no allow match and a callback set still gets through step 3. The deny check in step 4 is then the only real stop."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says that an unmatched call can pass step 3 when a callback is set. It never concludes that a tool matching neither list runs, and it describes "Permission denied" when there is no callback.
